sources: https://www.cityofmarysvilleks.com/servicesparks, read 2026-11-05: lists 'City Park - Located at South end of town from 10th & Walnut to 8th & Walnut ...' with no word on camping, RV sites, fees or rules; no other city page mentions camping (the city homepage's page list has none).

Google Maps 'Marysville City-RV Park' (RV park, 'Located in: Marysville City Park', R9Q3+4F3 S 10th St, 39.83776,-96.64633), 4.6 stars from 28 reviews, no phone listed; reviews read 2026-11-05: '2 weeks ago - Love the free hookups ...' (van camper, two nights); 'a year ago - The city park has free camping with a dump station, of course donations are accepted'; 'a year ago - ... the restrooms are being renovated, and were closed when I visited'; '3 years ago - free camping with electric, water and dump station ... there is a donation box with envelopes on the bathhouse next to dump station'.

Google Maps 'Marysville City Park' (park, 4.6 from 314 reviews), reviews read 2026-11-05: '2 months ago - It only has 3 spots with water and electric. No sewage but it has a dump station. Bring a long water hose.'; '3 years ago - There were only about 6 hookups if you have a big RV. We pulled in with a 36' converted bus and a car and fit fine'; '7 years ago - a few FREE 50 amp RV hookups, water included (Stay up to 5 days in a 30 day period), tent sites with electric and a dump at the entrance'; '10 months ago - due to construction on the road, the bathrooms were closed'.
visitmarysvilleks.org (the website on the Google listing), read 2026-11-05: a content site (an iGaming founder profile beside generic Marysville copy), no camping page - not an official tourism site.

Esri World Imagery 39.8375,-96.6460 at 200 m and 2.5 km half-widths, 2026-11-05: pin sits on the park's shaded lane off S 10th St, ~60 m from Google's listing point (pads not distinguishable under the canopy); the Big Blue River loops ~0.8-1.6 km to the west and south-west, beyond the US-77/railroad embankments. Overpass mirrors were all down, so distances are imagery estimates.

values.note: Free; a donation box with envelopes is on the bathhouse by the dump station (camper reports).

fees.source: Google Maps reviews of Marysville City-RV Park read 2026-11-05 ('2 weeks ago - Love the free hookups'; 'a year ago - free camping with a dump station, of course donations are accepted'; '3 years ago - donation box with envelopes on the bathhouse'). Camper reports; the city publishes no camping page.

hookups.source: Google Maps reviews read 2026-11-05: '2 months ago - only has 3 spots with water and electric. No sewage'; '7 years ago - a few FREE 50 amp RV hookups, water included'. Camper reports; the amperage rests on the older review only.

facilities.source: Google Maps reviews read 2026-11-05 ('2 months ago - ... it has a dump station'; '3 years ago - ... bathhouse next to dump station'). Showers were derived from directory note prose only and no review mentions them, so cleared.

sites.source: The stored 12 came from directory note prose; camper reports disagree ('2 months ago - only has 3 spots with water and electric'; '3 years ago - only about 6 hookups'; Campendium 4) and the city states no number, so cleared.

values.note: Five nights within any 30 days (camper report).

booking.source: Google Maps review read 2026-11-05, '7 years ago - ... (Stay up to 5 days in a 30 day period)'; recent reviews describe pulling in with no booking. Camper reports; the city posts no rules.

note: City of Marysville park on S 10th St under a canopy of trees, known for its black squirrels; a few RV spots with hookups (campers report 3 with water and electric, and a 36-ft bus fit), tent sites, bathhouse by the dump at the entrance. The city's own pages don't mention the camping; call City Hall (785-562-5331) to confirm. --Claude
summary: City website names City Park but says nothing about camping; presence rests on Google Maps (RV-park listing 4.6/28, reviews up to 2 weeks ago confirming free overnight camping with hookups) - public-ladder rung 3. Fees 0/0, dump, electric 50 + water, FCFS, 5-night max now reported from dated camper reviews; count 12 and showers false cleared (directory-only, contradicted). Not waterfront confirmed (Big Blue ~0.8-1.6 km away beyond embankments).
flags: PRESENCE (public ladder): the City of Marysville's parks page (https://www.cityofmarysvilleks.com/servicesparks) lists City Park but never mentions camping; no official tourism page found (visitmarysvilleks.org, the site on the Google listing, is now an iGaming-linked content site, not the CVB). Rung 3 holds: Google Maps 'Marysville City-RV Park' (RV park, 4.6 from 28 reviews, NO phone on the listing) with a review 2 weeks ago confirming an overnight stay on the free hookups. Keep, with the note's 'call City Hall' line.
PHONE 785-562-5331 is the City Hall number (city site); Google lists no phone for the RV park. WEBSITE: the stored city homepage has no camping content; no better official page exists.
SITES: stored count 12 cleared - camper reports range 3 (2 months ago, 'only has 3 spots with water and electric') to ~6 (3 years ago); 12 came from directory prose.
BATHROOMS: two recent reviews say the restrooms were closed (a year ago 'being renovated'; 10 months ago 'due to construction on the road'); not a campground closure - no status written.

REVIEW (2 weeks ago, quoted): a van camper says a fire marshal and police checked on campers and a dog in a van; one older camper 'was made to feel she had to leave' after 2 nights. Not a criteria issue; reported for the picture.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: Big Blue River ~0.8-1.6 km W/SW beyond the US-77 and railroad embankments (imagery estimate; Overpass down). SAND: none. PIN fine (~60 m from Google's point, on the park lane).
